runtime.note: Framework-dependent single-file binary. The host needs the .NET 10 runtime. Deliberately not Native-AOT: whisper.net and ONNX Runtime are heavy native interop, and the JIT startup cost is paid once per activation on a daemon that then lives for hours.

privilege.why: it reads two model files and writes nothing but its log
privilege.note: The socket's filesystem permissions (the deploying user, 0660) are the whole access boundary — every client is another service on this host running as the same account.

system.why: the daemon is socket-activated and idle-exits — the .socket is what gets enabled, the .service is pulled in on demand

recognition is around forty times faster on the card and synthesis around eight; without one, both fall back to the processor rather than refusing. cuDNN is needed for synthesis on the GPU specifically — a host with a card but no cuDNN speaks on the processor and hears on the card.

downloads.name: ggml-small.en.bin
downloads.note: Adopted from /var/lib/kgsm-bot/models when a host already has it from an earlier kgsm-bot install. KGSM_SPEECH_MODELS=0 skips the fetch.

units.note: Enable the .socket, not the .service. An inactive .service is this leaf's resting state: it wakes on a connection and exits again after Speech__IdleMinutes, which is the only way its ~1.6GB and ~1.1GB of video memory are ever returned.
